 North Promenade Liberty Station
 All Ages
 Free
 Liberty Station invites the community to celebrate the holiday season at its 2026 Salute the Season main event, the Liberty Station Tree Lighting & Holiday Festivities , taking place in the North Promenade and Vesper Venue on Friday, Nov. 27, from 5 to 9 p.m.
 Gather your loved ones and enjoy a magical evening of the iconic 88-foot Norfolk pine tree lighting as well as live entertainment, festive firetruck rides, and The Grinch movie showing.
 Thank you to our sponsor, San Diego Community Power, for powering the music for the Holiday Tree Lighting.
